comparator.name: Public Administration
comparator.sourceNotes: Current 2026–2027 OER Appendix3 p31 and the official year pages agree on one 180-EC framework: 60EC compulsory first year; 48EC compulsory second year plus12EC from four listed restricted options; and18EC compulsory advanced study,30EC genuine free choice in third-year semester1 and a12EC thesis. Retain the first two restricted options in the published list, Security in the Netherlands and Challenges in Policy Advising, selected neutrally before UCR matching and subject to capacity. No named route is required. Appendix4 pp32–33 explicitly accepts current replacements for the older methods prerequisites: thesis entry is90EC including Academic Skills, Public Administration Research Methodology and Applied Quantitative Methods. This sequence satisfies the conditions. European Governance excludes MAN-BCU348A, which is not selected. Free-space choices require approval/non-overlap; internships can be6,12or18EC and require90EC including the full first year. Mandatory academic Dutch language testing carries no additional credits. BSA normally42of60EC; attendance, interim work and proposal conditions apply as recorded in component notes. Appendix4 repeats BPRA201 next to quantitative methods, but Appendix3 and the current year-page course link unambiguously identify the separate quantitative unit as BPRA200; no unit or credit is duplicated. This is the current published framework; future offerings may change.

components.name: Societal Problems
components.note: Satisfactory tutorial assignments are required before submitting the final essay.

components.name: Academic Skills for Public Administration
components.note: A mandatory academic Dutch-language test is linked to a first-year course and adds no credits. Normally 42 of 60 first-year EC are required for positive study advice, with personal circumstances considered.

components.name: Policy Implementation
components.note: Seminar attendance and passing interim assignments are required.

components.name: European Governance
components.note: Not open to students who take or have taken MAN-BCU348A; that excluded unit is not selected here.

components.name: Applied Qualitative Methods
components.note: A satisfactory research proposal is required before submitting the final paper.

components.name: Security in the Netherlands: Policy and Organisation
components.note: One of two 6-EC restricted electives chosen neutrally from the first two positions in the official list. Places are limited; availability is not guaranteed.

components.name: Challenges in Policy Advising
components.note: The second neutrally chosen 6-EC restricted elective. Places are limited; the degree requires two of four listed options.

components.name: Governance in the Digital Age
components.note: The current regulations state that places are limited.

components.name: Free-choice space
components.note: 30 EC of genuine free choice in third-year semester 1. Outside courses require approval and non-overlap. A 6, 12 or 18-EC internship is optional; entry requires at least 90 EC including the full first year. Study abroad requires the applicable learning agreement.

components.name: Bachelor's Thesis in Public Administration
components.note: Required 12-EC thesis in periods 3–4. Entry requires at least 90 EC including Academic Skills, Public Administration Research Methodology and Applied Quantitative Methods (the explicitly accepted current replacements for older methods courses).

alternativeSelection.assessment: Three evidence-backed related routes respond to the defining public problem, policy, institution and organisational substance. General coherence or environmental/business labels alone do not establish comparability under the CP119 distinction. Five science/engineering placements in the climate route and three generic business placements in the organisations route are replaced with stronger public, social and empirical study. Housing and poverty remain evidenced public problems; the separate candidate lacks a sustained available housing-policy sequence beyond general economics and sociology, so it is not included under a new label. Public Policy Analysis exists in the workbook but is unavailable in the planned semesters and cannot fill that gap. Pairwise course differences are [{'pair': [1, 2], 'differentCourses': 8}, {'pair': [1, 3], 'differentCourses': 5}, {'pair': [2, 3], 'differentCourses': 9}]. The maximum of three is reached only after these substantive tests.

notes.text: These UCR routes offer substantial political, legal, economic, social and organisational analysis with empirical methods. Radboud provides a dedicated public-administration sequence in policy formation and implementation, Dutch administration, public-sector practice, digital government and a separate 12-EC thesis. UCR does not reproduce every specialist unit; optional independent research is additional to the scheduled 180 EC.

audience.programmeDescription: The Dutch-taught Public Administration degree studies how policy, government and public organisations shape societal problems, and how their effects can be understood and improved. It combines political, legal, economic and social perspectives with empirical research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Three UCR routes offer related study in public policy and institutions, climate governance, or public organisations and digital change. Radboud adds a dedicated public-administration sequence, Dutch policy practice and a separate bachelor thesis. The UCR routes develop related academic capacities and do not confer the same disciplinary qualification.
